notes.title: Time for a Speedrun with the new Achievements!
notes.notes:
Today we are adding 82 achievements. Each stage will have a "Time Challenge" achievement, that you have to defeat a developer time to earn it. A timer has also been added for you register your previous record!

You can check the Achievements list to see all the developers times. Good luck!
